caption.text:
Stock art is why your carousel looks like everyone else's.

This deck was not drawn in Figma. Every plot here is vector geometry generated from the spec you are reading — seeded from the deck id and the slide id, so it is identical on your machine and mine.

Four of the eight styles are on the slides. The engine ships eight: topography, orbital, halftone, isometric, flowfield, constellation, moire, ribbon.

Save this if your next deck should look like it came from an instrument, not a template library.

slides.headline: Every frame here drew itself
slides.alt_text: Dark cover with paper-white type reading Every frame here drew itself, a mint badge reading NO STOCK, and a row of plot ticks.
slides.sub: Eight plotter styles, one seed, zero stock photos.
slides.kicker: The eighth slide is the point:

slides.headline: Terrain is just data with a horizon
slides.alt_text: Framed contour-ring plot in mint and grey, captioned FIG. 01 CONTOUR DRIFT, above the headline Terrain is just data with a horizon.
slides.sub: Contour rings walked out of a hash of the slide id. Nothing here was traced.
annotations: no network requests at render time

slides.headline: Momentum you can trace back
slides.alt_text: Framed flow-field plot of mint streamlines curving to the right, above the headline Momentum you can trace back.
slides.sub: Streamlines follow a smooth field, so the eye has somewhere to go that is not a decorative swoosh.

slides.headline: Stock says "business". A seed says this slide.
slides.alt_text: Two-column contrast: STOCK LIBRARY versus GENERATIVE PLOT, with the verdict One is a mood. The other is evidence you can re-run.

left.label: STOCK LIBRARY
left.text: Same gradient, same whiteboard, same deck as forty other accounts.

right.label: GENERATIVE PLOT
right.text: Geometry computed from this deck's own id: owned, reproducible, unrecognisable from someone else's post.

slides.verdict: One is a mood. The other is evidence you can re-run.

slides.headline: Halftone, without the photograph
slides.alt_text: Framed halftone dot field shading from grey edges into a dense mint core, above the headline Halftone, without the photograph.
slides.sub: Dot mass falls off from a focus point: photo texture, generated from one number.
annotations: no image asset in the bundle

slides.headline: Three fields and the deck draws itself
slides.alt_text: Three-step playbook explaining the art block, the style field and the seed field.

steps.title: Add the block
steps.detail: One slide with layout: generative needs only a headline.

steps.title: Name a style
steps.detail: art.style picks topography, orbital, halftone, isometric, flowfield, constellation, moire or ribbon.

steps.title: Print the seed
steps.detail: art.seed locks the look; the caption can cite the fingerprint on the frame.

slides.headline: Every cycle gets a compass
slides.alt_text: Framed orbital dial of mint arcs, satellites and tick marks, above the headline Every cycle gets a compass.
slides.sub: Arcs, satellites and graduations: a cadence you can read at thumbnail size.
